speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing confusion, abdominal pain, and vomiting. To understand the severity of your condition, have you had any fever, recent travel, or changes in your mental status over the last few days?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old female. The patient presents to the emergency department with confusion that started this morning. The patient's husband reports that she initially complained of abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fatigue after eating and has vomited 3 times. The patient has progressively become more confused throughout the day. The patient's past medical history includes morbid obesity, diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, a sleeve gastrectomy 1 month ago, and depression with multiple suicide attempts.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) post-sleeve gastrectomy.

I see you have a history of diabetes and had a sleeve gastrectomy one month ago. Given your confusion, vomiting, and abdominal pain after eating, have you been able to keep any fluids down or take your insulin recently? Also, have you noticed your breath smelling fruity or your urine being very frequent?
